limitations: This is one of six planned seed-by-probability-stream analyses; the 1000-replicate cross-cohort uncertainty phase is not complete.
Held-out score archives were generated by a reconstructed local evaluator, not a byte-identical repository checkout.
Both cohorts are from the same PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019 benchmark; this is not prospective clinical validation.
Metrics concern hourly challenge labels, not patient-level clinical events, lead time, or real-world false-alarm burden.
VITALIS is research-only and must not be used for diagnosis, triage, or treatment.
privacy: Aggregate-only artifact. Score vectors, raw patient data, and patient group IDs are not included.
